question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Consensus for Apple FQ4 2026 diluted EPS is $1.99 (27 analysts, range 1.93-2.07); year-ago $1.85. Apple has beaten consensus 8/8 quarters, typically 2-10% (adjusted: 1.91 vs 1.88, 2.01 vs 1.92, 2.84 vs 2.65, 1.85 vs 1.73). Q3 GAAP $2.02 included +$0.11 tariff refunds; repeat refunds are upside risk. Q4 guide of 9-11% revenue growth (below ~12% street) with FX drag and supply constraints tempers the beat. GAAP-specific tail: one-off tax charges (Q4 FY24 GAAP $0.97) justify a small below-range mass. No prediction market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold.

calls.reconciliation: Consensus differences across runs ($1.96/$1.98/$1.99) are aggregator noise and immaterial. Run 3's bottom-up ($2.00-2.03) used opex ~$18.5B, below the guided $19.1-19.4B; recomputing with guided opex gives ~$1.95-1.97, matching Run 2. So guidance midpoint sits slightly below consensus and the above-consensus median rests on Apple's consistent beat history (about 3-5% expected, tempered because the Q3 beat included one-off tariff refunds and memory costs are rising). Median $2.05: near Runs 1 and 3 but grounded in the beat pattern, not Run 3's flawed bottom-up. Low tail (>$15B one-off charge) priced at 1.5% per the FY24 EU precedent. No upper escape mechanism. No web access this run; market check relies on the runs, which all found none.
